== About these guides ==
Catanova is an independently developed, open-source game inspired by CATAN. These are original Catanova guides, not an official CATAN publication. Three- and four-player games follow the base-game target; the [[Getting started|two-player option]], [[Map generation|balanced map preset]], and [[Turn timer|timer]] are Catanova choices. Rare development-card cases are marked where their rulings remain provisional.

For the complete specification, use the [https://github.com/shashwtd/catanova/blob/main/docs/RULEBOOK.md Catanova rulebook] and [https://github.com/shashwtd/catanova/blob/main/docs/RULE_SOURCES.md compatibility notes]. See [[Project:Copyrights]] for reuse of this wiki's starter text.
